description: The public read-only view of the pipeline's single URL allow-list (§3.7a, D15), for a UI that has to explain a rejected link before it reaches the markup. The list cannot be extended by a host: http, https, mailto, tel, a relative path without an authority and a #fragment pass; every other scheme and every network/UNC path is refused.

members.name: BlockedUrlPlaceholder
members.description: The value a refused URL is replaced with in the markup.

members.name: FindBlockedScheme
members.description: Returns the offending scheme (or the pseudo-scheme network-path) or null when the URL may be emitted.

members.name: IsAllowed
members.description: Answers whether a URL may be emitted into the message.
